::: {#def-iteration}
#### Iteration (unrolling)

Solving a recurrence relation (@def-recurrence-relation) by **iteration**, also called **unrolling**,
finds a closed form (@def-closed-form) for its sequence in three steps:

1. use the recurrence relation again and again to write $a_n$ in terms of $a_{n-1}$, then $a_{n-2}$, then $a_{n-3}$, and so on;
2. guess, from the pattern, a formula for $a_n$ in terms of $a_{n-k}$ for every number $k$ of steps;
3. choose $k$ so that $a_{n-k}$ is an initial term, and put in its value.

:::
